method: Direct visual inspection of four rendered reader and representative record captures
observations: Scope summary and download cards remain readable on mobile
Inventory identity, status transition and interpretation are visually distinct
The no-evidence case is explicit rather than a blank result
Desktop records and controls have consistent spacing with the library
scope: Captured summary and representative record at 390 and 1440 pixels; all 366 records and filters checked separately. Not a full manual accessibility certification.
